preservedElements: All seven tickers on page 1/3 of the source table
The one-year return column as printed
changedElements: Layout plan: one column of the table redrawn as a ranked bar chart

Colour plan: neutral grey bars with the Micron bar accented
Language plan: all visible strings translated to English
